question: What victory in battle is gained by meditating on Hanumat as the slayer of Akṣa?
premises: Hanumat is contemplated as the slayer of Akṣa
inference: By meditating on Hanumat as the slayer of Akṣa, one would conquer in battle
plain_english: Thus meditating on the slayer of Akṣa, one would conquer in battle.
